The '''sister of [[Tarrin Datch/Legends|Tarrin Datch]]''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], one of several children born to her [[Datch family|parents]], though she was the only [[Gender/Legends|girl]]. She, along with her siblings, assisted her parents in performing flight shows for [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] waiting for their [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] to be serviced at the family owned [[Pellezara station]]. After Tarrin left to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], he knew better than to involve the rest of his family in the turmoil of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
